answer.text: Make sure the motorcycle is upright and on its centre stand.
Make sure the gears are in neutral and the neutral lamp is glowing in the instrument console.
Switch OFF both the ignition and the stop switch, wait a few seconds, then switch the ignition and the stop switch ON again to start the engine.

watchouts.text: Pull in and hold the clutch lever before using the electric start.
Push and hold the electric start switch until the engine starts, for a maximum of 5 seconds.
If the malfunction indicator does not turn OFF, get the motorcycle checked through a Royal Enfield Authorised Service Centre.
